producer_report.summary: Added `xtask fingerprint` (athena_git::attrs::fingerprint of HEAD under HEAD's rules) and `xtask ci-cache check|mark|report`. The 'fmt, clippy, tests' job now builds xtask with the runner's `cargo +stable` before setup and restores `ci-pass/` under `ci-pass-<fingerprint>`. `check` says skip only if the restored marker names that fingerprint. On a skip, the job reports the fingerprint and matched key to the log and step summary, and skips the restores, setup, checks and shared saves. Otherwise it runs in full. After the checks step, `mark --outcome <checks outcome>` writes the marker only for `success`, and `actions/cache/save` stores it, on PR branches too. The three shared caches are still saved only from the default branch. xtask now depends on athena-git; the architecture table is updated. D121 and a CHANGELOG entry record the mechanism, the 15.4-minute median over 33 jobs, the alternatives, and that the after-figure is not measured. The workflow has not run on GitHub, so the cold xtask build cost and the `+stable` toolchain choice are untested. I ran the `cargo test` suite once, but its output was too large to read, so I confirmed the xtask tests (10 fingerprint, 11 policy) and the athena-cli ontology and audience tests individually.

checks_run.note: 33 unit, 10 fingerprint, 11 policy, 16 spec and 6 walltime tests pass
These tests read docs/decisions.md; both pass
Full suite run once, before the clippy fix to policy.rs. Output was too large to read, so its overall result is not confirmed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds a temporary git repo and shows the printed fingerprint is unchanged by a records-only change and by an owner-path change, and changes after a governed change.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --offline -p xtask` passes. xtask/tests/fingerprint.rs `fingerprint_ignores_records_and_owner_paths` and `fingerprint_changes_with_governed_content` build a temp git repo with .gitattributes owner rules and run the xtask binary `fingerprint`.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test of the step script/workflow logic shows a missing entry or a failed run leads to the full job and no save, a hit of a passing entry skips the build and checks, and the save happens only after the checks pass.
criteria_check.evidence: fingerprint.rs `ci_cache_*` tests pass. A missing or empty dir gives skip=false. A foreign marker gives skip=false. Failure, cancelled, skipped and empty outcomes write no marker. Success then check gives skip=true. policy.rs `the_pass_is_marked_and_saved_only_after_the_checks_and_the_shared_caches_stay_default_branch_only` asserts the step order checks < mark < save.

criteria_check.criterion: .github/workflows/ci.yml keeps the job name 'fmt, clippy, tests'; the cache lookup (actions/cache/restore, key from the xtask fingerprint) comes before 'Set up'; setup, the checks and the existing cache steps are skipped on a hit; the new save step runs only when the checks succeeded.
criteria_check.evidence: policy.rs `the_checks_job_looks_up_its_earlier_pass_before_setup_and_skips_on_a_hit` passes. It finds the job by name, checks that the lookup comes before 'Set up', and checks that every step after the gate except the hit report carries `steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'`. The save step has no always()/failure() and follows the mark step.

criteria_check.criterion: Saving is done on pull-request branches for their own fingerprint entries, while the shared toolchain/registry/target caches are still saved only from the default branch; the entry is written under a key that includes the fingerprint and a marker whose presence means 'passed' (a failed run never writes one).
criteria_check.evidence: The pass save step has no default-branch or pull_request condition, and its key is `steps.fingerprint.outputs.key` (`ci-pass-<fp>`). The three shared saves keep the default-branch condition, which the policy test asserts. `mark` writes only for outcome `success`, which the failed-run test covers.

criteria_check.criterion: The hit step reports the reused result in the log and step summary (fingerprint and matched key), so a reader can see why the build was skipped.
criteria_check.evidence: The ci.yml step 'Report the reused pass' runs `ci-cache report` with the fingerprint and `steps.ci-pass.outputs.cache-matched-key`, passes --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", and runs only on skip == 'true'. `ci_cache_report_names_the_fingerprint_and_the_matched_key` checks both stdout and the summary file.

criteria_check.criterion: The fingerprint comes from athena-git's `fingerprint` (not a reimplementation); any dependency or architecture-doc change this needs keeps `dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture` passing.
criteria_check.evidence: xtask/src/ci_cache.rs calls `athena_git::attrs::fingerprint(&git, "HEAD", "HEAD")`. I added athena-git to xtask/Cargo.toml and changed the xtask row in docs/architecture.md to 'data, git'. `dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture` passes.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has an entry giving the mechanism, the measured landing median before (15.4 minutes over 33 jobs, 2026-10-23 to 25), the alternatives considered, and that the after-figure is not yet measured; CHANGELOG.md has a matching entry.
criteria_check.evidence: docs/decisions.md D121 covers the mechanism, the 15.4 min over 33 jobs figure, alternatives (a) to (f), and the unmeasured after-figure. The CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry matches. The athena-cli ontology and audience tests, which read decisions.md, pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo clippy --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings` is clean after fixing one collapsible-if. `cargo fmt --all --check` is clean. `cargo test --offline -p xtask` passes. I ran the full `cargo test --offline` once, but its output was too large to read, and I did not find its pass or fail result. I checked the athena-cli ontology and audience tests separately and they pass. I did not run the other workspace crates' tests in isolation. The untouched workspace-wide test run is therefore not confirmed here.

open_issues: The workflow has never run on GitHub. The cold `cargo +stable build -p xtask` before setup, and whether the runner's stable cargo accepts the workspace rust-version, are untested.
The after-measurement of the landing median is deferred, as the brief says.

Plan departure: the plan named a `--outcome` mark in the sequence test and a policy test, and both exist. I put the hit report as a third subcommand, `ci-cache report`, as the plan allowed. I used a text-based parse of ci.yml in policy.rs because no YAML parser is a dev-dependency.
mistakes: The first clippy run flagged a collapsible `if` in my policy.rs helper; fixed.
I ran the full `cargo test` before that fix and could not read its output, so I did not confirm the whole suite.
learnings: `--locked` fails after a dependency edge is added until Cargo.lock is refreshed; an `--offline` build refreshed it.

ci.yml and rust-toolchain.toml are governed paths: .gitattributes marks only CLAUDE.md, BRIEF.md and LICENSE as owner paths. So editing the workflow changes the fingerprint and cannot reuse a stale pass.
dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture compares the docs/architecture.md table with `cargo metadata`, so adding an edge means editing the table row.
Bash hooks in this environment forbid `git grep` and paths outside the working directory.
decisions.md has no format test beyond what athena-cli reads; the latest entry was D120.
desires: A way to read large tool output stored outside the working directory, so the full-suite result could be confirmed.
A way to dry-run the workflow, for example with act, to test the cold xtask build and `cargo +stable` choice.
